### Circumcision of the Heart
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/circumcision-of-heart
Passage: Romans 2:28-29
Points:
- External heritage, ritual observances, and moral sincerity do not guarantee right standing before God.
- Practical human obedience remains insufficient to meet the righteousness required for justification.
- The Old Testament demonstrates that God's people have always depended on His gracious atonement rather than personal works.
- Authentic circumcision is an inward work of the Holy Spirit changing the heart, not an outward physical mark.
- Righteousness before God comes only to those with renewed hearts who trust in Christ alone.
